changes.observation: Wood-coloured grained face becomes dark petrol, reducing the original wood-material conflict.
Plant/books/roller/tray removed; hair and clothing hatching simplified into large planes.
All eleven correct entries, left title/spine and continuous printing-to-reading page are retained.
Face simplification introduces stronger circular-eye cartoon treatment; head scale and three-quarter geometry persist; English still tilts.

residuals.limit: Oversized three-quarter heads and circular cartoon eyes remain rather than compact adult profiles.
English remains tilted, and its line sits farther left than the assigned horizontal reader-facing area.
Top striations remain; dark thickness is clearer, but elastomer flexibility is not strongly expressed.
Rows retain the earlier start and wider spacing, though they remain readable and in order.
